svg.metadata: {"story":"Jeremiah","act":10,"chapter":"Ch.10 · Lament and Hope","scene":"A","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"The Lord promises a new covenant written on the heart, and a voice in Ramah is comforted: your work shall be rewarded.
